anatomy.styleNote: 8.2 HU measured, not assumed: hair-crest tip to chin is 0.122 of total figure height. Between realistic (7.5) and heroic; far from anime-adjacent (5-6). The design is deliberately long-legged -- crotch at 0.543 of height against a real figure's 0.47-0.49, knee at 0.337 against ~0.285.
